_comment: Copy to config.json (install.sh does it) and change what you need. Remove keys you do not change.
_timezone: IANA name, e.g. America/Toronto. Empty = this computer's local time. Days in the Week tab follow it.
_projectsDir: Folder where sessions started with the + buttons open.
_adoOrg: https://dev.azure.com/<organization>. Turns work item numbers into links and resolves PRs (needs the az CLI). Empty = off.
_appDataDir: Claude Desktop data folder. Empty = auto-detect (WSL: /mnt/c/Users/*/AppData/Roaming/Claude, Linux, macOS).
_sections: Names of YOUR sidebar sections per stage (case-insensitive). The first name is the label on the board.
_skills: Skills the two + buttons ask Claude to use. Use your own skill names.

startMessages.review: Use the {skill} skill to review PR {n} and place this session in the "{section}" section.
startMessages.implement: Use the {skill} skill for ticket {n} and place this session in the "{section}" section.
